name: openpixo/model-from-image
title: 3D model from image
description: Turns one reference image of a prop or character into a textured 3D model (GLB). Needs a provider with image-to-3D support.

description_i18n.en: Turns one reference image of a prop or character into a textured 3D model (GLB). Needs a provider with image-to-3D support.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把一张道具或角色参考图转成带贴图的 3D 模型（GLB），需要支持图生 3D 的供应商。

recipe.prompt: A clean, game-ready 3D model of the single object in the reference image: one closed mesh, centered at the origin, standing upright on the ground plane, with real-world proportions and textures matching the image. Ignore the image background.
recipe.negative: background, ground plane, pedestal, multiple objects, floating parts, holes, text
